verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a cloud telephony SaaS like Aircall, but nothing in the evidence documents choosing a storage region or residency. The tutorial on importing recordings into your own infrastructure (aircall-docs-8) is a user-side export workaround, not a residency control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
